footnotes: Banks have no cost of sales; the flow chart shows revenue (net interest income + noninterest income) going to noninterest expense and the provision for credit losses, leaving pre-tax income. From pre-tax income to net income to common: after income tax and $45.2M of preferred dividends & other. Efficiency ratio = noninterest expense ÷ revenue (lower is better).
Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue (net interest income plus noninterest income) rose 1.6% to $681M in 2025. Net interest income fell 1.1% to $517M and noninterest income rose 11.0% to $164M; noninterest expense rose 34.0%, and the provision for credit losses was $118M, versus $24.3M.
Net income to common fell 38.8% to $174M, or $3.78 per diluted share, and the efficiency ratio was 44.0% versus 33.4%. Merchants Bancorp returned $59.4M through dividends.
